summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of DZ Prime Academy 2026 Next.js multi-tenant EdTech platform. All 33 backend pytest tests pass (100%). All critical frontend flows work end-to-end: page loading, persona hydration, admin tab switching, KPI display, real-time sync (teacher→dawarat→admin→student), settings modal, language switching (AR/FR RTL/LTR), payout approval. Zero console errors on all major pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Ambassadors API POST/PUT/DELETE routes not implemented - only GET exists. If admin should add/edit ambassadors via UI, add these handlers.
Students PUT endpoint uses `id` from body and does not validate role transitions; consider a dedicated /api/students/[id]/verify route for cleaner REST semantics.
Course POST does not persist teacherId when teacherName is supplied without id - future teacher-scoped queries may return incomplete data.
Session POST has no server-side validation of scheduledAt (accepts any date, including past dates).
Prisma seed uses ensureSeeded on every API GET call - though idempotent (Wilaya-count guard), consider caching per-boot with an in-memory flag to skip the extra COUNT query on hot paths.
test_credentials: N/A - persona-switching demo app, no login required. Personas auto-hydrate per route/subdomain.
seed_data_creation: Test suite created several TEST_-prefixed courses, teachers, sessions, modules and one UITEST_ course via the teacher UI to validate real-time sync. All persist in Supabase Postgres. Consider running a cleanup query for TEST_/UITEST_ prefixed rows if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://bcc84ba1-4451-4fcb-9a1e-ea90aeabba51.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend at /app/backend is a FastAPI reverse-proxy forwarding /api/* to Next.js on 127.0.0.1:3000. All backend API routes are Next.js route handlers under /app/frontend/src/app/api/*. DB is Supabase Postgres (pooler ap-northeast-1) - allow 3-5s for first data fetch. Use data-testid selectors: admin-tab-{financial|teachers|students|sessions|ambassadors|courses}, sidebar-nav-settings, teacher-add-course-btn, approve-payout-{id}. Teacher course form is inline (NOT modal) with placeholders 'العنوان (عربي)' + 'Titre (FR)' and submit button text 'نشر فوراً'. Real-time sync flow verified: course created on /ar/teacher immediately appears on /ar/dawarat, /ar/admin#courses, /ar/student. Persona hydration is per-route on first mount but persists across role routes once localStorage is set - to test admin persona freshly, clear localStorage first.
